input.change_text: Improved OpenRouter model metadata handling by introducing a local cache, increasing reliability and performance.

output.subject: aider caches OpenRouter model metadata locally
output.action_text: Upgrade `aider` to 0.83.2+ if you route through OpenRouter — the SDK now caches model metadata locally instead of fetching on every invocation. Faster startup and fewer transient failures when OpenRouter's metadata endpoint hiccups.
